summary: The per-case endpoint names made the contrast measurable: CheckRun a7083e51d44b4b1589eeb21b40848782 records the non-snapshot case violated (aborts) and the snapshot case holding (completes), bounding the asserted defect to entries without snapshots. Extended the same experiment with the gap's other half — the identical request against the captured persistent (RocksDB) backend — which locally also aborts, with a different site and message: 'Error reading from storage.: ErrHelper' raised inside the core crate at sequence_paxos/mod.rs:428, since PersistentStorage::get_suffix errors for a below-compaction request. Submitted as a further revision with a third comparison and admission.
